Hi Dana,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday — excited to get AcmeOps set up as an approved vendor so we can start issuing POs. To keep the procurement and finance teams moving, could you please share the items below by EOD next Tuesday (July 3)?

Required items:
- Legal entity exact name (as it should appear in Redwood's ERP)
- Company registration number and jurisdiction
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- Signed W-9 (or W-8 if applicable) — we included a template
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, routing, last 4 digits) — we only need a redacted bank stub for initial verification
- Primary PO/invoice contact (name, email, phone)

Optional but helpful:
- Preferred remittance note (e.g., invoicing email or vendor portal URL)
- Any EDI/ERP vendor code you already use with customers

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (blank form), w9_template.pdf (fillable)

A couple of notes on ERP mapping: our finance team typically maps vendors by exact legal name plus a 6-character vendor code. If you have a canonical name you want to use, please indicate it exactly (capitalization, punctuation). If you have a preferred vendor code (alphanumeric), include that and we'll try to match it. If not, we'll assign a Redwood vendor code and share it prior to the first PO.

If you prefer, you can upload docs to the secure folder I created: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/onboarding/AcmeOps-2028

Thanks — I can follow up with a DocuSign ACH link once finance confirms the tax docs.

Best,
Kimberly Park
